title: Panda's Spruce Biome!
description:
A Calm Biom For Any Calm Play. A Forest Full Of Nature And Life! 
Perfect For Any Create Mod Build!
body:
**_THIS MOD IS STILL UNDER DEVELOPMENT! SOME MINOR BUGS MAY OCCUR, BUT WE ARE WORKING TO FIX THEM AS SOON AS POSSIBLE_**



This mod adds a new biome called: "The Panda's Favorite Biome"! It features a mix of jungle, spruce, and azalea trees, along with dense foliage to give it a unique and natural look.
It also includes 3 new structures: a rusted, wrecked car, and two types of small stone formations that mainly generate within the new biome!
